interpretation_limits: Five later export directories merely preserve the existing submission:ambiguity V1,V2 and LoRA V5,V6,HSE V7. HSE throughV8 has8 result directories but only3 unique CSVs.
Development validation was repeatedly used for checkpoint/architecture/EMA/TTA/fusion/weight selection; a+2or+9 correct gain is a selection estimate and cannot establish Kaggle improvement.

OOF uncertainty is from baseline/cosine heads on the same DINO feature family,not independent human adjudication or proof of incorrect labels. Strong downweighting can suppress genuinely difficult valid examples and change effective class priors.
Only V5,V6,V7 provide matched algorithm controls;all are one-seed finite-setting comparisons. Raw/EMA best-checkpoint comparisons reuse validation and do not establish a causal EMA benefit.
Single-model accuracy and fusion accuracy answer different questions. Official DDAM epoch0 is weaker alone but more complementary than its fine-tuned successor.
V8 gain is attributable descriptively to replacing the20percent CNN branch with an official pretrained DDAM branch under one fixed reused-dev comparison,not to six-epoch local training.
Early metadata marks internal test as previously observed;this audit ignores those scores and no untouched holdout is established here.
No actual Kaggle leaderboard score has been read or verified;the user-reported failure to improve is compatible with repeated identical CSVs and small dev-only gains.
